name: switch
description: Group that shows only one child at a time (like Moho's switch layer): the one named by active, or the first one if active is null. Used for mouths, visemes, eyes or hands that change drawing. Poses and params choose the child by changing active.
help: Group that shows one child at a time, like a Moho switch layer: the active one, or the first. Poses and parameters change it.

active.help: Visible child. Empty = the first one (the one at the back).
active.description: id of the visible child. null = the first one (the one at the back).
